source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Models waiting to [fight on death](vsdata:core-rule/inflict-damage) count as on the battlefield, for every rules purpose, until removed. Among other things:

- friendly and enemy abilities can measure to them
- friendly and enemy models can treat them as **visible** where it matters
- their datasheet abilities still work
- **stratagems** can target them
- enemy units may remain **engaged** with them, which can limit the other player's **consolidation moves** and **pile-in moves** during an **overrun fight**
